title: ampacus littoralis
intro: Ampacus littoralis, commonly known as Red Sea Cactus, is a species of succulent plant native to the tropical regions of the Red Sea. The health benefits of Ampacus littoralis include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as skin conditions, wounds, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Ampacus littoralis, including flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin, and alkaloids like ampacin and ampacine.
